_about: Read by .github/scripts/ga4-admin.mjs (Ship tail): every entry must exist in the GA4 property; missing ones are created, nothing existing is ever archived, deleted, renamed or changed. timeZone is the property's reporting time zone, set when it differs, because /live and the weekly report count Israel days. Event-scoped parameters the app sends (index.html track()) that the reports read: analytics/ga.py, analytics/experiments.py, worker/live/worker.js. property = GA_PROPERTY_ID in worker/live/wrangler.toml.

customDimensions.description: car_lookup, lookup_failed, share, search_no_result, link_landing: what kind (weekly report, /live)
car_lookup: 1 when a source failed (weekly report)
car_lookup: brand, never the plate (weekly report)
search_no_result: the cleaned search term (weekly report)
tab_view: 1 when the car viewed is saved, so the tab read of 22.11 splits owners from buyers
upgrade_open, car_save, update_prompt: where it was opened from (weekly report)
car_save, buy_step_done, settlement_shown: a small count
every web event: where the visit came from (utm_source of /go/ links, share, google, direct...) (/live sources)
every web event of a visit that came by a tagged link: its topic (utm_campaign, ?c= of /go/ links) (/live sources, per post)
